$comment: Single source of the attribution patterns (Python re, flags IGNORECASE|MULTILINE). Read by the ops sweep and commit-message-check.sh. Edit here only. A trailer-shaped pattern that eats the rest of its line is anchored at the line start, so prose quoting a trailer keeps its text.

identity.comment: Matched against the author and committer name and email of each commit (Python re, IGNORECASE).

merge-branch.comment: Matched against the subject of a merge commit: a branch or pull request head under claude/.

house.$comment: who commits in every OpenMixer repository, judged by the commit-msg hook before the commit exists: the author, name and email, and the committer's email (the cluster's signer and the desk commit as it)
house.author: Pau Aliagas <linuxnow@gmail.com>
